name: MOST SACRED PRIESTESS
source:
You are the Daughter-Saint - the latest in a line of reincarnations. The Celestial Mother sent you to this realm to act in her place, as her mouthpiece and living god. You must wrestle with your mortal body,  discarding its lowly desires to better attune yourself to the spark of Her flame within you. Your Knight-Commander is making this exceedingly difficult.

Even though the knights are a poisonous gift from the King,  said to "protect you" but meant to extend his influence into your sacred temple,  you've let one into your heart. She - and yes, you're the only person who knows she's a girl - has bewitched you, with her radical ideas about "freedom" and "questioning the sacred traditions" and "giving oral sex". You must resist. 

[From [url=https://bastardisgaytion.itch.io/most-sacred-priestess]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是圣女——轮回系列中最新的一个。天母派你到这个领域来代替她行事，作为她的代言人和活神。你必须与你的凡人身体搏斗，抛弃它卑微的欲望，以便更好地调和你体内她的火焰火花。你们的骑士指挥官让这件事变得极其困难。

尽管骑士是国王送来的有毒礼物，据说是为了“保护你”，但实际上是为了将他的影响力扩展到你的神圣圣殿，但你已经让其中一个进入了你的内心。她——是的，你是唯一知道她是女孩的人——用她关于“自由”、“质疑神圣传统”和“口交”的激进思想迷住了你。你必须反抗。

[来自[url=https://bastardisgaytion.itch.io/most-sacred-priestess]itch.io[/url]]
